```{r}
# 5.3 Face Detection and Recognition
library(image.libfacedetection)
library(opencv)
library(magick)

# Load photo
img <- image_read("C:/Users/collin/Downloads/R images/WhatsApp Image 2026-10-26 at 11.49.13.jpeg")

# Detect faces (extracts bounding box coordinates)
faces <- image_detect_faces(img)

# Display detection results dataframe in console
print(faces$detections)

# Plot photo with red boxes around detected faces
plot(faces, img, border = "red", lwd = 2)
```
```{r}
# Convert faces data frame coordinates to crop boxes
detections <- faces$detections

if (nrow(detections) > 0) {
  # Loop through each detected face and crop it
  for (i in 1:nrow(detections)) {
    crop_geo <- sprintf("%dx%d+%d+%d", 
                        detections$width[i], 
                        detections$height[i], 
                        detections$x[i], 
                        detections$y[i])
    
    face_crop <- image_crop(img, crop_geo)
    
    # Save each cropped face
    image_write(face_crop, sprintf("cropped_face_%d.jpg", i))
  }
}
```
```{r}
detections <- faces$detections

if (!is.null(detections) && nrow(detections) > 0) {
  # Loop through each detected face, crop, save, and print
  for (i in 1:nrow(detections)) {
    crop_geo <- sprintf("%dx%d+%d+%d", 
                        detections$width[i], 
                        detections$height[i], 
                        detections$x[i], 
                        detections$y[i])
    
    face_crop <- image_crop(img, crop_geo)
    
    # Save cropped face to disk
    image_write(face_crop, sprintf("cropped_face_%d.jpg", i))
    
    # --- DISPLAY OUTPUT IN NOTEBOOK ---
    print(face_crop) # Forces display of the cropped face image
  }
} else {
  print("No faces detected in the image.")
}
```
```{r}
# Plot image first
plot(img)

# Annotate each box with confidence percentage
if (nrow(detections) > 0) {
  rect(detections$x, detections$y, 
       detections$x + detections$width, 
       detections$y + detections$height, 
       border = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  # Add text labels above the bounding boxes
  text(x = detections$x, y = detections$y - 10, 
       labels = paste0("Face: ", round(detections$confidence[i] * 100, 1), "%"), 
       col = "red", cex = 1.2, font = 2)
}
```
```{r}
library(magick)
library(image.libfacedetection)

# Load image and detect faces
img <- image_read("C:/Users/collin/Downloads/R images/WhatsApp Image 2026-10-26 at 11.49.13.jpeg")
faces <- image_detect_faces(img)
detections <- faces$detections

if (nrow(detections) > 0) {
  # Sort face bounding boxes by height
  tallest_idx <- which.max(detections$height)
  shortest_idx <- which.min(detections$height)
  
  print(paste("Tallest/Largest Face Index:", tallest_idx, "with height:", detections$height[tallest_idx], "px"))
  print(paste("Shortest/Smallest Face Index:", shortest_idx, "with height:", detections$height[shortest_idx], "px"))
  
  # Highlight tallest face in green, shortest in blue
  plot(faces, img, border = "red")
  rect(detections$x[tallest_idx], detections$y[tallest_idx], 
       detections$x[tallest_idx] + detections$width[tallest_idx], 
       detections$y[tallest_idx] + detections$height[tallest_idx], 
       border = "green", lwd = 3)
  rect(detections$x[shortest_idx], detections$y[shortest_idx], 
       detections$x[shortest_idx] + detections$width[shortest_idx], 
       detections$y[shortest_idx] + detections$height[shortest_idx], 
       border = "blue", lwd = 3)
}
```
